nodes.name: VK Webhook
nodes.notes: responseMode MUST be responseNode, or VK never confirms the address.

nodes.name: Respond Confirmation
nodes.notes: Bare plain text. Needs N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false.

nodes.name: Respond OK
nodes.notes: Answer FIRST, think after. VK retries a slow endpoint; a retry would log the receipt twice.

nodes.name: Secret Valid?
nodes.notes: The URL is public. The shared secret is what makes a request trustworthy.

nodes.name: Drop — Bad Secret
nodes.notes: VK already got its 'ok'. An attacker learns nothing.

nodes.name: Normalize VK Event
nodes.notes: Generated from builds/vk-adapter/normalize-vk.js. Do not edit here.

nodes.name: Seen Before?
nodes.notes: No Redis on this box, so the dedup ledger is a Data Table. Data Tables have no unique constraint — this is check-then-insert. At this volume the race is unreachable; swapping in Redis later is a one-node change.

nodes.name: Already Processed?
nodes.notes: VK retries deliveries. Without this, one photo becomes several expense rows.

nodes.name: Has Image?
nodes.notes: doc_unsupported (a PDF) deliberately fails this and goes to the text branch, which explains itself rather than crashing OCR.

nodes.name: Download Image
nodes.notes: VK serves the photo URL directly in the payload — no getFile round-trip, and no 1-hour expiry as with Telegram.

nodes.name: Image To Base64
nodes.notes: Yandex Vision takes base64 in the JSON body, not a multipart upload.

nodes.name: Yandex Vision OCR
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: Name='Authorization', Value='Api-Key <your key>'. Api-Key, NOT Bearer. Endpoint verified working against real receipts on 2026-09-03.

nodes.name: OCR To Text
nodes.notes: Generated from builds/01-receipt-bot/ocr-text.js. Vision's lines carry NO text field — only words[].text — so lines must be rebuilt by joining words.

nodes.name: OCR Usable?
nodes.notes: A blurred photo returns junk, not an error. Below the bar it goes to review rather than inviting a hallucinated receipt.

messageValues.message:
Ты — парсер российских кассовых чеков. На входе — распознанный текст чека, строки могут идти не по порядку.

Верни ТОЛЬКО JSON, без пояснений и без markdown-блока:
{"vendor":"","expense_date":"ДД.ММ.ГГГГ","total":"","currency":"RUB","category":"","confidence":0.0,"multiple_receipts":false,"raw_text":""}

Правила:
- total — ИТОГОВАЯ сумма покупки. Не бери суммы из строк СВЕРКА ИТОГОВ, ЧЕКОВ ВОЗВРАТА, ВНЕСЕНИЙ, ВЫПЛАТ, КОМИССИЯ — это не расход.
- Передавай сумму и дату КАК НАПЕЧАТАНО в чеке, включая апострофы и знак '='. Не исправляй символы сам — этим занимается отдельный проверяющий слой.
- Если в тексте несколько разных чеков (несколько блоков TID/RRN/СУММА) — поставь multiple_receipts=true и не выбирай один из них.
- category: еда, такси, транспорт, топливо, связь, канцтовары, аренда, реклама, прочее.
- confidence 0.0-1.0 — насколько ты уверен в vendor, дате и сумме.
- Ничего не выдумывай. Неизвестное поле оставь пустой строкой.

nodes.name: Extract Fields
nodes.notes: Extraction only. The model never decides whether a value is valid — Validate Receipt does that deterministically.

nodes.name: Qwen 3 (Yandex AI Studio)
nodes.notes: OpenAI credential with Base URL https://llm.api.cloud.yandex.net/v1 and the Yandex API key. temperature 0 — extraction, not writing.

nodes.name: Validate Receipt
nodes.notes: Generated from builds/01-receipt-bot/normalize.js. Repairs OCR glyph confusion in NUMERIC fields only; vendor text is never character-substituted. 39 tests, incl. the real receipt corpus.

nodes.name: Log For Review
nodes.notes: A parse failure is still recorded, with its reason. Never a silent drop and never an automated rejection.
